snippets.snippet_text: "Feature Gaps: Compared to a full Stripe integration or larger platforms like FastSpring, LemonSqueezy has a narrower focus. It also lacks some advanced funnel customization. So if you need sophisticated checkout flows or alternative business models, you may outgrow it." and "Limited Payment Flexibility: LemonSqueezy's checkout is simpler, but that means fewer options. If you later need to expand beyond card/wallet payments, it may be restrictive. USD-Centric & Fees: All transactions settle in USD. This is fine for US-based creators, but non-US sellers pay extra due to currency fluctuations."

possible_subjects: Lemon Squeezy review by Dodo Payments (2026): Lemon Squeezy has narrower feature set compared to Stripe or FastSpring; lacks advanced checkout customization; limited payment method options beyond card and wallet; all transactions settle in USD, creating currency conversion costs for non-US sellers
